name: Motosumiyoshi Maria
source:
A maid in the service of the Yuutenji family and Masachika's caretaker.

She is a sweet and tender maid who loves her young master, she handles his sexual desires as well as arranges his meetings with other girls. She will do anything Masachika desires.

In reality, however, they have an affection for each other that goes beyond the relationship of master and servant.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/haramase/index.html]official site[/url]]
